data.name: BeMeebeth
data.description:
It's alive!" Not since the creation of the Wubbox has Monsterkind witnessed such a significant scientific achievement. The gargantuan BeMeebEth represents the pinnacle of Zarroë's mad tinkering and endless experimentation. The Ethereal Quint towers over the other denizens of the Ethereal Workshop, inspiring awe and apprehension in equal measure. Visible in its unstable composition are all five Ethereal Elements: Plasmic tentacles, Shadowy claws, Crystalline cartilage, pockmarked Poisonous spines, and the Mech-nical jaw that houses its mighty brain. From the moment it erupted from the Synthesizer's upper bulb, there was no question that this Monster was the Top Boss of the Workshop. ” — Monster Bio

Contents 1 Description 2 Song 3 Synthesizing 4 Likes 5 Statistics 5.1 Earning Rate and Maximum Income 5.2 Feeding Monsters 6 Possible Monster Names 7 Gallery 8 Notes Description BeMeebEth is a Quint-Element Ethereal Monster found on Ethereal Workshop. It was added alongside Epic G'joob and Epic Yawstrich on September 4th, 2024, during version 4.4.0. As a Quint-Element Ethereal on Ethereal Workshop, it is obtained by successfully extracting the energies of a Plasma Meeb, a Shadow Meeb, a Mech Meeb, a Crystal Meeb, and a Poison Meeb, using the Ultra-Mega-Super-Hyper-Refined Synthesizer. Its successful Synthesis time is 2 Days and 7 Hours. As a Quint-Element Ethereal, BeMeebEth has an excellent Shard production. The Goal for placing your first BeMeebEth rewards the player with 100 diamonds.

Song Audio:

Voice Actor: Landen Purifoy using a talk box

BeMeebEth contributes with a synthesized voice, mostly singing non-lyrical vocalizations, while harmonizing with other Monsters on Ethereal Workshop, such as Yooreek, Piplash, Nitebear, Auglur, Whaill, and Pentumbra. It also sings the following English lyrics:

"Creations of a mastermind!" "We are the workshop!" "Monstrosities of monster kind sing here!" "Our song is simply too unstable!" "Oh Yeah!" Synthesizing BeMeebEth is only available for purchase or synthesizing on Ethereal Workshop. As a Quint-Element Ethereal, it requires a pre-existing Quad-Element Ethereal to "build upon". BeMeebEth, being a Quint-Element Ethereal, requires a certain amount of Meebs attuned to each of the Quad-Element Ethereal's Elements, and a certain amount of Meebs attuned to the fifth Element in the Ultra-Mega-Super-Hyper-Refined Synthesizer. After a successful synthesis, the Synthesizer will be on cool-down for 48 hours before it can be used again. The following Quad-Elementals can be used to synthesize BeMeebEth:

Whaill Portrait+Neutral Meeb Portrait+Poison Meeb Portrait Whaill (Plasma ElementShadow ElementMech ElementCrystal Element) + 2 of each Attuned Meebs of Whaill's Elements (Plasma ElementShadow ElementMech ElementCrystal Element) + 3 Poison Meebs Vhenshun Portrait+Neutral Meeb Portrait+Crystal Meeb Portrait Vhenshun (Plasma ElementShadow ElementMech ElementPoison Element) + 2 of each Attuned Meebs of Vhenshun's Elements (Plasma ElementShadow ElementMech ElementPoison Element) + 3 Crystal Meebs Pentumbra Portrait+Neutral Meeb Portrait+Mech Meeb Portrait Pentumbra (Plasma ElementShadow ElementCrystal ElementPoison Element) + 2 of each Attuned Meebs of Pentumbra's Elements (Plasma ElementShadow ElementCrystal ElementPoison Element) + 3 Mech Meebs Rhysmuth Portrait+Neutral Meeb Portrait+Shadow Meeb Portrait Rhysmuth (Plasma ElementMech ElementCrystal ElementPoison Element) + 2 of each Attuned Meebs of Rhysmuth's Elements (Plasma ElementMech ElementCrystal ElementPoison Element) + 3 Shadow Meebs Oogiddy Portrait+Neutral Meeb Portrait+Plasma Meeb Portrait Oogiddy (Shadow ElementMech ElementCrystal ElementPoison Element) + 2 of each Attuned Meebs of Oogiddy's Elements (Shadow ElementMech ElementCrystal ElementPoison Element) + 3 Plasma Meebs There is no indication that Synthesis chances are affected by what combination is used. Of the five Quad-Element Monsters you can use, Whaill is the easiest to obtain, as it is the most stable out of the five combinations. Note that the successful synthesis of BeMeebEth will result in the Quad-Element Ethereal Monster being lost in the process.

Likes Cozee Cabin Cozee Cabin Go to Cozee Cabin 1/4 Every Monster has different things that they like. For every unique object that they like that's placed near the Monster, the Monster's happiness will increase by 25%. Placing more than one of the same liked item near a Monster won't increase its happiness by an additional amount. If there's a Unity Tree on the Island, items don't need to be near the Monster. Below are the things liked by BeMeebEth:

Cozee Cabin (requires level 19) Spurrit Statue (level 15) Dragon Tower (level 20) Jarhead (level 21) (Mystery Like) See the Likes page to view a complete list of all Monsters' likes.

Statistics Earning Rate and Maximum Income

Earning rate is in Shards per hour and depends on Happiness % (Likes increase Happiness) and Monster Level. Each Monster also has a maximum amount of income it can hold at a time. Increasing the Monster's Level also increases this limit.

Level Per Hour Shards Maximum Shards Feeding Monsters

The feeding rate for BeMeebEth has yet to be determined, however if it follows the pattern of other Ethereal Monsters, (Starting at 20 treats per Element) it would start out at 100 treats per feeding, meaning that it would require 92,978,800 treats to feed to Level 20, which is the most amount of required food out of any Monster.

Possible Monster Names To see all possible names for BeMeebEth, see Monster Names.

Gallery Idle animation Idle animation Promotional image Promotional image BeMeebEth's Wordmark BeMeebEth's Wordmark Promotional image in Play Your Part 2024 Promotional image in Play Your Part 2024 Notes BeMeebEth's name is a portmanteau of "Behemoth", "Meeb", and "Eth"ereal. BeMeebEth is: One of the two most unstable Ethereal Monsters, tied with Oogiddy with an instability score of 120. The Monster that takes up the most beds out of any Monster, being 25 total. The only monster besides Wubbox and its variants to take up a 4x4 grid. The only Quint-Element Monster in the Ethereal class, and the only one to not be classified as a Natural or Fire Monster. The first English-speaking non-Electricity Element or Legendary Monster. The first Monster to be announced in Anniversary Month 2024. The last Common Ethereal Monster to be added to the game overall. The last Quint-Element Monster to be added to the game as of now. The third Monster to be voiced by a content creator, the first being Shugabush and the second being Shugavox. BeMeebEth marks the third time a brand new Monster was revealed through the Play Your Part contest, the first being Kayna in the Tribal Island Play Your Part, and the second being the Psychic Monsters (and by extension, the Magical Monsters) in the Fire Frontier Play Your Part. Prior to Ethereal Workshop's release, Landen Purifoy, BeMeebEth's voice actor, teased Auglur's sound and silhouette in a video. Landen also appeared in the August 2024 Handler Hangout on August 1st, before BeMeebEth was revealed. BeMeebEth's multiple arms and general shape resemble the Lyriks, an early concept for the Werdos. It is currently unknown whether this resemblance is intentional. It also resembles Meebkin, with its shoulder pads as upper body resembling Meebkin's head. It is unknown whether this is also intentional, but it would make sense as both Monsters reference Meebs directly. It also bears a resemblance to Orange Prismatic Barrb, as it shoulders pads has green spikes and similar pattern to Orange Prismatic Barrb's head. This is likely coincidental. BeMeebEth is one of very few Monsters to have a unique wordmark, as most wordmarks are only given to Islands or in-game features and mechanics. BeMeebEth is the only Monster on Ethereal Workshop to only like Decorations, and the only one on the Island to not be liked by any other Monsters.
